description: Main source code for controlling LEDs on a device using Zephyr RTOS, including color setting, blinking, and device initialization.

methods.name: scale_color_to_percent
methods.description: Scales a hex color value [0x00..0xFF] to a percentage [0..100].

methods.name: set_static_color
methods.description: Sets the RGB LEDs to a static color based on provided red, green, blue values.

methods.name: blink_color
methods.description: Blinks the RGB LEDs in specified colors with given on/off delays.

methods.name: turn_off_all_leds
methods.description: Turns off all LEDs connected to the device.
